import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector

bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)

def material(name, color, metallic=0.0, roughness=0.5):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.diffuse_color = (*color, 1)
    m.use_nodes = True
    p = m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color, 1)
    p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = roughness
    return m

def box(name, loc, scale, mat, bevel=0.03):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=loc)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.dimensions = scale
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    o.data.materials.append(mat)
    if bevel:
        b = o.modifiers.new('Soft edges', 'BEVEL')
        b.width = bevel
        b.segments = 3
        o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals', 'WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def cylinder(name, loc, radius, depth, mat):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=32, radius=radius, depth=depth, location=loc)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.data.materials.append(mat)
    b = o.modifiers.new('Edge rounding', 'BEVEL')
    b.width = 0.012
    b.segments = 2
    o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals', 'WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def label(body, loc, size, mat):
    bpy.ops.object.text_add(location=loc, rotation=(math.pi / 2, 0, 0))
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = 'Seat number ' + body
    o.data.body = body
    o.data.align_x = 'CENTER'
    o.data.align_y = 'CENTER'
    o.data.size = size
    o.data.extrude = 0.001
    o.data.materials.append(mat)

import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector

bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)

def material(name, color, metallic=0, roughness=0.45):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.diffuse_color = (*color, 1)
    m.use_nodes = True
    p = m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color, 1)
    p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = roughness
    return m

def box(name, loc, dims, mat, bevel=0.015, rotation=None):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=loc)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.dimensions = dims
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    if rotation:
        o.rotation_euler = rotation
    o.data.materials.append(mat)
    if bevel:
        b = o.modifiers.new('Rounded edges', 'BEVEL')
        b.width = bevel
        b.segments = 3
        o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals', 'WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def rod(name, a, b, radius, mat):
    a, b = Vector(a), Vector(b)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=32, radius=radius, depth=(b-a).length, location=(a+b)/2)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.rotation_euler = (b-a).to_track_quat('Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    o.data.materials.append(mat)
    for p in o.data.polygons:
        p.use_smooth = True
    return o

# Revolved closed cross-section: exterior, rolled rim, interior and cavity floor.
profile = [(0,0), (0.13,0), (0.16,0.035), (0.115,0.085), (0.13,0.12), (0.23,0.22), (0.255,0.36), (0.225,0.46), (0.135,0.54), (0.115,0.66), (0.155,0.69), (0.16,0.715), (0.135,0.728), (0.113,0.697), (0.09,0.66), (0.109,0.535), (0.199,0.449), (0.228,0.357), (0.206,0.23), (0.104,0.14), (0,0.14)]
verts, faces = [], []
segments = 64
for r, z in profile:
    for j in range(segments):
        a = 2*math.pi*j/segments
        verts.append((r*math.cos(a), 0.075+r*math.sin(a), 1.205+z))
for i in range(len(profile)-1):
    for j in range(segments):
        k = (j+1) % segments
        faces.append((i*segments+j, i*segments+k, (i+1)*segments+k, (i+1)*segments+j))

bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=list(bm.verts), dist=0.00001)
bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=list(bm.faces))
bm.to_mesh(mesh)
bm.free()
for poly in mesh.polygons:

def box(name, loc, dims, mat, bevel=0.01):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=loc)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.dimensions = dims
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    o.data.materials.append(mat)
    if bevel:
        b = o.modifiers.new('Machined edges', 'BEVEL')
        b.width = bevel
        b.segments = 3
        o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals', 'WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def rod(name, a, b, radius, mat, vertices=32):
    a, b = Vector(a), Vector(b)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=vertices, radius=radius, depth=(b-a).length, location=(a+b)/2)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.rotation_euler = (b-a).to_track_quat('Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    o.data.materials.append(mat)
    bevel = o.modifiers.new('Rim bevel', 'BEVEL')
    bevel.width = min(radius*0.15, 0.006)
    bevel.segments = 2
    o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals', 'WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def disk(name, x, y, z, radius, depth, mat):
    return rod(name, (x,y-depth/2,z), (x,y+depth/2,z), radius, mat, 64)

    o.data.align_y = 'CENTER'
    o.data.size = size

import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector

bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)

def material(name, color, metallic=0, roughness=0.4):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.diffuse_color = (*color,1)
    m.use_nodes = True
    p = m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color,1)
    p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = roughness
    return m

def rod(name,a,b,radius,mat):
    a,b = Vector(a),Vector(b)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=40,radius=radius,depth=(b-a).length,location=(a+b)/2)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.rotation_euler = (b-a).to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler()
    o.data.materials.append(mat)
    bevel = o.modifiers.new('Soft edges','BEVEL')
    bevel.width = min(0.012,radius*0.2)
    bevel.segments = 3
    o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def ball(name,loc,radius,mat):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=24,ring_count=16,radius=radius,location=loc)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.data.materials.append(mat)
    for p in o.data.polygons:
        p.use_smooth = True
    return o

def bent_wood(name,points,radius,mat):
    curve = bpy.data.curves.new(name,'CURVE')
    curve.dimensions = '3D'
    curve.resolution_u = 24
    curve.bevel_depth = radius
    curve.bevel_resolution = 5
    curve.use_fill_caps = True
    s = curve.splines.new('BEZIER')
    s.bezier_points.add(len(points)-1)
    for p,co in zip(s.bezier_points,points):
        p.co = co
        p.handle_left_type = 'AUTO'
        p.handle_right_type = 'AUTO'
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name,curve)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o)
    o.data.materials.append(mat)
    return o
